Name: Style
Description: Select from A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, or L. Each option represents a distinct pre-defined texture style, allowing you to experiment and choose the look that best fits your terrain.

Name: Factor
Description: Primary driver controlling the overall strength or intensity of the selected style. Higher values increase the prominence of the texture effect.

Name: Secondary
Description: Adjusts the strength of secondary effects such as soil accumulation, flow streaks, and breakup patterns. Use to fine-tune the complexity and realism of the texture.

Name: Seed
Description: Randomizes the pattern while keeping other settings the same, allowing for variation without the need to re-tune parameters.

Name: Components
Description: Group containing individual texture components that can be enabled or adjusted to refine the final appearance.

Name: Flows
Description: Simulates natural erosion channels and directional streaks, adding realism by mimicking the effects of water or wind movement across the terrain.

Name: Slope
Description: Adds slope-based weighting to the texture, favoring either steeper or flatter areas to enhance natural variation.

Name: Soil
Description: Controls soil-like accumulation in flatter regions, adding natural buildup and enhancing the realism of the terrain surface.
